component.name: PS VulkanPlay
component.summary: Play your console on this computer over the network

description.p: PS VulkanPlay is a Remote Play client for PS5 and PS4 consoles, written from the ground up: the console's picture in a window drawn with Vulkan, its sound, and a controller with what the console sends back for it.

ul.li: Your consoles as cards: play, wake one from rest mode, add one step by step
Usable with a controller alone, from the couch
A DualSense gets haptics, trigger effects and the light bar's color over USB
The picture keeps going over lost frames, and a cushion of delay can hide a wireless network's short pauses

description.p: This program is not affiliated with, endorsed or certified by the maker of the consoles.
Decoding on the graphics card, a menu over the stream, reconnecting by itself, HDR pictures tone mapped to the desktop, scaling and debanding, controller settings, and Add to Steam.
The first pre-release: the app, playing over the home network, DualSense features over USB.
